concept.title: Creating links
concept.shortdesc: Links are created from an artifact's editor / link panel:

ol.li: Select the source artifact and open its editor.
Pick a link type — only types valid for the source artifact's type are offered.
Pick the target artifact — the list is filtered to types the chosen link type allows.

conbody.p: Both the app and the server enforce these rules, so an invalid combination (say, a requirement "verifying" a hazard) is rejected with an explanation.
